text: Migrations are not atomic: a failed or raced migration bricks the database

Landed. Each migration runs in an explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE with the version re-read inside the transaction, so a failed migration rolls back its DDL and a worker that loses the race does not replay. Cheap probe outside the transaction keeps an up-to-date database from taking the write lock on every connect. I re-ran my own brick reproduction: after a failing migration the column is absent, user_version is unchanged and a corrected retry applies. Concurrent-worker test made deterministic with a trace callback rather than threads (30/30 runs).
